features.schema2: contains exists, but accepted factory uses exact mappings and authoritative package/UID boundaries. Widening requires owner decision
features.upstream: Case-sensitive strstr; first linked-list hit, reverse constructor order; includes incomplete package strings

features.schema2: Factory general 2-6, C1 2-4, C2 7 on SM8650; upstream numerical tuple on this topology not proven
features.upstream: Mode indexes three 12-byte tuples at state+0x48; selectors resolve through topology table, then sched_setaffinity

features.schema2: Explicit CPU 0..7 sets supported; no qualified topology/mode-to-mask transform
features.upstream: sched_setaffinity uses a 4-byte mask; selected category 1/2 and other tasks differ; mode/topology selects masks

features.schema2: ZUIopt explicitly returns no representative when rank exceeds candidate count. Preserve the safe deviation; do not call it lossless
features.upstream: Representative helper can return a non-category candidate if that category is absent; dummy-main demotion can leave too few category-2 candidates

features.schema2: Cannot faithfully split one pattern's ranked candidates across two masks with class-consistent rank/mask. Current G23 patterns alone do not encode this
features.upstream: __DoubleMain internally relabels the first category-2 candidate to category 1, then reselects category 2 for the C1 placement slot. Original first candidate keeps C2 placement; the second gets C1 placement. Normal C1 competition is bypassed

features.schema2: No mode field or WALT operations; cannot map to Uperf modes
features.upstream: Validated integer 0..2; indexes topology-dependent mask tuple. Mode 2 has conditional fallback to 0 and WALT/pipeline path; meanings of numerical mask tuples remain unqualified

features.schema2: No realtime/scheduler writes. rt is not competition rank
features.upstream: Any nonzero rt selects SCHED_RR(2)|SCHED_RESET_ON_FORK(0x40000000), priority 1, for selected category representatives. rt=0 uses SCHED_OTHER/priority 0 when restoring prior RT state

features.schema2: Rule priority controls classifier precedence only; no task scheduler policy
features.upstream: sched_setscheduler priority 1 or 0 and policy 0x40000002 or 0; rule category values are not scheduler priorities

features.schema2: Intentionally not implemented by ZUIopt; exact full kernel write sequence remains outside qualified affinity projection
features.upstream: WALT per-task boost/reduce-affinity/pipeline interfaces, /dev/cpuset/asopt, scheduler rt_runtime_us/rt_period_us paths observed

features.schema2: No per-game mode/rt fields. Resolver edge cases and reload timing not claimed equivalent
features.upstream: Config grammar %127s %d %d stores package + mode + rt; per-game resolver uses first contains match, else global mode=%d and rt=%d; effective owner-device values not sampled

features.schema2: No global AsoulOpt mode/rt authority; effective runtime configuration is unknown
features.upstream: Global mode/rt defaults and overrides influence per-game state
No uclamp/nice/setpriority interface observed in qualified imports/strings; this is not a whole-daemon absence proof
